$comment: Read by `serve` from build/serve.json (CRA copies public/ into build/).
Replaces `serve -s`, which rewrote EVERY unknown path to index.html and
answered 200. That made a misrouted request - an integration pointed at
the wrong URL, say - indistinguishable from a working one.
Only the app's real client-side routes fall back to index.html here, so
deep links and refreshes still work while anything else 404s.
Keep this list in sync with web/src/pages/routes.tsx.
